item.title: DHS Announces Final Rule Establishing Weighted Selection Process for Cap-Subject H-1B Petitions
item.description: On December 23, 2025, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) announced that it finalized its proposal to overhaul how U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) selects H-1B registrations for H-1B cap-subject petitions. The final rule replaces the random selection with a weighted, wage-level based selection that operates alongside the beneficiary-centric system adopted in 2024. item.title: IP Considerations for Life Sciences Companies
item.description: Life sciences companies operate around long development timelines, high regulatory hurdles, and enormous capital requirements. item.title: New York Governor Signs Ban on Worker ‘Stay or Pay’ Requirements
item.description: On December 19, 2025, New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a bill into law that prohibits certain “stay or pay” agreements that require employees to repay their employer for specific training costs if the employee leaves before a specified period. The law took effect immediately. Quick Hits New York’s “Trapped at Work Act” bans “stay or pay” agreements that require repayment of training costs if employees leave employment. item.title: New Jersey Adopts New Rules Clarifying and Reinforcing Disparate Impact Liability
item.description: On December 15, 2025, the New Jersey Division on Civil Rights (DCR) issued new comprehensive rules that codify and reinforce disparate impact liability under the New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (LAD) in employment and other contexts. The rules, which aim to codify existing case law in New Jersey, come as the federal government has ceased enforcing federal antidiscrimination laws based on disparate impact theories, instead focusing on intentional discrimination. item.title: DHS Announces ‘Weighted Selection Process’ to Allocate H-1B Visas Effective Feb. 2026
item.description: Takeaways DHS announced in a final rule that it will apply a new H-1B selection process, replacing the random lottery, to allocate cap-subject H-1B visas beginning with FY 2027. item.title: New York State Enacts Historic Consumer Protection Bill – Expands Scope of GBL 349
item.description: As previously covered here and here, in March 2025 the Office of the Attorney General for the State of New York introduced the Fostering Affordability and Integrity Through Reasonable (“FAIR”) Business Practices Act in the State Senate and State Assembly. item.title: China’s National People’s Congress Releases Foreign Trade Law With IP Chapter – Launching a Chinese ITC?
item.description: On December 27, 2025, China’s National People’s Congress (NPC) released the Foreign Trade Law of the People’s Republic of China (中华人民共和国对外贸易法) effective March 1, 2026.
